customer: So I've got this station wagon I put a ridiculous number of miles on every week driving back and forth for work, and I was finally getting ready to sell it to you, but I tore the house apart and can't find the title anywhere. I think it might've gotten tossed when I cleaned out the glovebox, honestly no idea. I'm in Eastvale, so what do I even do now, and how long is this going to hold things up?
agent: No problem, you can apply for a duplicate title at any Eastvale motor vehicle office, just bring your photo ID and registration. Eastvale issues paper titles, and the main offices print duplicates the same day, while going by mail takes 2 to 3 weeks. Once you have it, bring the duplicate with you to your appointment and we'll take it from there.
